description: Merchandise trade (imports/exports) by commodity, partner, and flow direction at HS 6-digit level. Most comprehensive bilateral trade dataset globally.
variables: Reporter, partner country, HS commodity code, trade value (USD), net weight (kg), quantity, year, flow direction
citation: United Nations Statistics Division. UN Comtrade Database. comtradeplus.un.org
limitations: Free API: 500 calls/day, 250 records/call. Premium for bulk. Pre-2017 data in Comtrade Legacy. Reporting gaps for smaller economies

provider: CEPII (Centre d'Études Prospectives et d'Informations Internationales)
description: Harmonized bilateral trade flows reconciling FOB exporter and CIF importer figures using mirror statistics. Cleaner than raw Comtrade.
variables: Exporter, importer, HS6 product code, value (USD thousands), quantity (tonnes)
citation: Gaulier, G. & Zignago, S. (2010). "BACI: International Trade Database at the Product-Level." CEPII Working Paper 2010-23
limitations: Annual lag of ~2 years; no services trade; no real-time updates

description: Portal integrating UN Comtrade, UNCTAD TRAINS, WTO IDB. Enables tariff + trade query in one interface.
variables: Imports/exports by HS/SITC, tariff rates (MFN, preferential), NTMs, trade competitiveness indicators
citation: World Bank. World Integrated Trade Solution. wits.worldbank.org
limitations: Not a primary data source — aggregates others. Some coverage gaps. API limited to UNCTAD TRAINS subset

description: Applied tariffs, bound duties, and import/export statistics at HS-6 or HS line level for 150+ WTO members.
variables: Applied MFN tariff, bound tariff, preferential tariff, import value, export value, HS code, reporter, partner
citation: World Trade Organization. Tariff & Trade Data. ttd.wto.org
limitations: Data depends on WTO member notifications; some countries lag years. Bound tariffs static.

dataset_name: Harvard Growth Lab — Atlas of Economic Complexity (SITC Rev.2 & HS)
description: Cleaned bilateral trade flows using Bustos-Yildirim mirror-flow correction. Multiple HS and SITC revisions.
variables: Exporter, importer, product code, trade value, Economic Complexity Index (ECI), Product Complexity Index (PCI)
citation: The Growth Lab at Harvard University. International Trade Data (SITC, Rev.2). Harvard Dataverse. doi:10.7910/DVN/H8SFD2
limitations: Free access requires Dataverse registration; large file sizes

provider: St. Gallen Endowment for Prosperity Through Trade (SGEPT)
description: Independent database of unilateral commercial policy interventions (tariffs, subsidies, export restrictions, FDI barriers) — not government self-reported. 78,000+ documented interventions.
variables: Intervention type (Red/Amber/Green), implementing country, affected sectors, HS products, partner countries, date implemented/removed
citation: Evenett, S.J. (ed.). Global Trade Alert. globaltradealert.org
limitations: Some interventions may not be discovered immediately; classification can be contested

description: Bilateral gravity data for all country pairs: GDP, population, distance, shared language, colonial ties, trade agreements. For gravity model estimation.
variables: Bilateral distance, contiguity, colonial history, common language, FTAs, GDP, population, trade flows
citation: Head, K., Mayer, T., & Ries, J. (2010). "The Erosion of Colonial Trade Linkages after Independence." CEPII WP 2009-07
limitations: Not trade flows data itself; must be merged with Comtrade/BACI

description: Semiannual macroeconomic database: GDP, inflation, unemployment, current account, fiscal indicators, projections. 45 indicators, ~200 countries.
variables: Real GDP, GDP growth, inflation (CPI), unemployment, current account balance, fiscal balance, gross debt, trade balance, FX reserves
citation: International Monetary Fund. World Economic Outlook Database. imf.org/en/publications/sprolls/world-economic-outlook-databases
limitations: Vintage data: download URL changes each release cycle; annual frequency only for most series

description: Flagship World Bank statistical database: 1,400+ indicators, economic + social + environmental. Near-real-time updates.
variables: GDP (nominal/PPP), GDP per capita, GDP growth, trade (% of GDP), FDI, inflation, poverty headcount, Gini, external debt
citation: World Bank. World Development Indicators. databank.worldbank.org
limitations: Some indicators sparse for low-income countries; significant lags in national account revisions

description: Harmonized national accounts data: GDP components (expenditure, income, production), quarterly and annual. OECD members + key partners.
variables: GDP, gross fixed capital formation, household consumption, government expenditure, exports/imports of goods and services, value added by sector
citation: OECD (2026). OECD National Accounts Statistics. doi:10.1787/na-data-en
limitations: Coverage primarily OECD countries; methodological revisions create breaks in series; limited sub-annual data for many countries

description: Indicators of soundness of financial institutions: capital adequacy, asset quality, earnings, liquidity. Core + additional indicators.
variables: Capital adequacy ratio, NPL ratio, return on assets, return on equity, liquidity ratio, bank leverage, loan-to-deposit ratio
citation: International Monetary Fund. Financial Soundness Indicators (FSI). data.imf.org
limitations: Significant reporting lag (up to 12 months); coverage varies substantially across jurisdictions

description: Monthly spot prices for 72 commodities: energy, metals, agriculture. Historical going back to 1960. Price forecasts twice yearly.
variables: Crude oil (Brent, WTI, Dubai), natural gas, coal, gold, copper, iron ore, wheat, maize, soybeans, coffee, sugar, fertilizers
citation: World Bank. Commodity Markets. Pink Sheet. worldbank.org/en/research/commodity-markets
limitations: Spot prices only; no futures or options data; limited sectoral breakdown

description: Monthly commodity price indices (fuel and non-fuel) and actual market prices. Feeds into IMF forecasting models.
variables: Energy index, non-fuel index, metals index, food index, beverage index, agricultural raw materials; actual prices for 60+ commodities
citation: International Monetary Fund. Primary Commodity Price System (PCPS). data.imf.org
limitations: Monthly frequency; no granular product-level breakdown beyond top-line categories

dataset_name: NY Fed Global Supply Chain Pressure Index (GSCPI)
provider: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
description: Composite index of global supply chain pressures based on container/bulk shipping costs, airfreight, and manufacturing PMI surveys. Expressed in standard deviations from historical mean.
variables: GSCPI value (std deviations), Baltic Dry Index contribution, Harpex contribution, airfreight contribution, manufacturing PMI components (delivery times, backlogs, inventories)
citation: Benigno, G. et al. (2022). "The GSCPI: A New Barometer of Global Supply Chain Pressures." NY Fed Staff Report No. 1017
limitations: Single global index — does not disaggregate by region or sector; based on mostly US/European inputs

dataset_name: World Bank Global Supply Chain Stress Index (GSCSI-M)
description: Port-centric metric of delayed container shipping capacity using AIS tracking data. Provides port, country, regional, and global stress levels in TEUs.
variables: Stalled ship capacity (TEUs), port-level stress score, country-level aggregation, regional aggregation, GSCSI composite
citation: Arvis, J.-F., Rodrigue, J.-P., Ulybina, D. & Rastogi, C. (2026). "A metric of global maritime supply chain disruptions: The GSCSI-M." Journal of Transport Geography 131
limitations: Port-centric; based on Panamax+ vessels only; AIS coverage gaps in some regions

description: Measures the value added by each country in the production of goods and services that are consumed worldwide. Reveals true trade dependencies vs. gross trade flows.
variables: Domestic value added in exports, foreign value added content, backward/forward GVC participation, bilateral value-added linkages
citation: OECD (2023). Trade in Value Added (TiVA) Database. doi:10.1787/trade-data-en
limitations: Significant publication lag (3–4 years); 2020 is latest coverage; does not capture recent GVC restructuring

description: Annual symmetric input-output tables for 76 economies × 45 sectors. The underlying database for TiVA. Used for supply-chain propagation modeling.
variables: Intermediate flows by sector-country pair, final demand, value added, taxes and subsidies, gross output
citation: OECD (2023). "Development of the OECD Inter-Country Input-Output database." OECD STI Working Paper 2023/08
limitations: 3–4 year publication lag; Chinese and Mexican tables have special disaggregation requiring aggregation

description: Identifies critical import dependencies at HS6 product level, specifies strategic sectors, and flags leading exporters.
variables: Dependency indicator, strategic sector flag, leading exporter flag, concentration index, share of imports from top supplier
citation: CEPII (2024). GeoDep Database. cepii.fr
limitations: Binary dependency flags based on threshold rules; methodology choices affect results

description: Benchmarks trade logistics performance across countries using shipment-level tracking data (AIS, aviation, postal). Replaced survey-based LPI in 2025 edition.
variables: Overall LPI score, customs efficiency, infrastructure quality, international shipments, logistics competency, tracking/tracing, timeliness; speed and connectivity sub-indices
citation: World Bank (2025). Logistics Performance Indicators 2.0. lpi.worldbank.org
limitations: Only biennial; 2025 methodology change breaks comparability with 2007–2023 series; subjective (survey-based edition)

description: Monthly early-warning indicators designed to anticipate turning points in economic activity. Includes OECD-wide and country-specific amplitudes of business cycles.
variables: CLI, trend-restored CLI, normalised CLI, business confidence index, consumer confidence index
citation: OECD (2026). Composite Leading Indicators (MEI). oecd.org/en/data
limitations: Not directly about logistics; useful for early-warning of demand-driven supply chain pressures

dataset_name: US International Trade Administration (ITA) Trade Data
description: US export and import statistics, trade finance, and trade facilitation data. Country/sector/product breakdown.
variables: US goods exports/imports by country and industry, trade deficits, tariff codes, trade finance indicators
citation: US Department of Commerce. ITA Trade Data. trade.gov/data
limitations: US-centric; limited to one reporter country

description: Daily port-level vessel traffic data and trade estimates derived from AIS (Automatic Identification System) data covering 1,000+ global ports. Updated weekly.
variables: Vessel calls by type, cargo TEUs, daily port activity index, trade flow estimates by commodity type, transit time, port congestion indicator
citation: IMF PortWatch Team. IMF PortWatch. portwatch.imf.org. Cite as: IMF-PortWatch@IMF.ORG
limitations: AIS signals can be spoofed or missed; dark shipping not captured; some ports have sparse signals

description: Quarterly index measuring how well countries are connected to global container shipping networks. Based on 5 components: number of ships, container capacity, max vessel size, services, companies.
variables: LSCI score, number of ships deployed, container carrying capacity, max vessel size, number of services, number of companies
citation: UNCTAD (2026). Liner Shipping Connectivity Index. unctadstat.unctad.org. Based on MDS Transmodal data
limitations: Does not capture port efficiency or inland logistics; index value not additive across countries

provider: Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW)
description: Real-time trade flow estimates for 75 countries using AI-based container ship tracking (2 million+ ship positions/year from Fleetmon.com). Price-adjusted.
variables: Price-adjusted import/export estimates, container ship port calls, cargo loaded/unloaded estimates, trade growth rates
citation: Stamer, V. (2021). Kiel Trade Indicator. IfW Kiel. ifw-kiel.de
limitations: ~6 week lead vs. official statistics; estimation uncertainty; limited backward history; model-dependent conversion of draught to cargo

description: Freight rate benchmarks: Baltic Dry Index (BDI), Baltic Capesize Index, Baltic Tanker Clean/Dirty routes.
variables: BDI, Baltic Capesize Index (BCI), Baltic Panamax Index (BPI), Harpex container index, freight rate per route (e.g., Capesize C5 Brazil–China)
citation: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. FRED Economic Data. fred.stlouisfed.org
limitations: Baltic Exchange primary data is proprietary and paid; FRED provides daily index only; route-specific rates require paid subscription

description: Annual factbook covering global semiconductor market size, US market share, R&D investment, employment, and 24-year trend data.
variables: Global semiconductor sales (USD billions), US market share (%), regional breakdown (Americas, Europe, Japan, APAC), R&D expenditure, capex, employment
format: PDF (free), underlying data XLS (members only for full databook)
citation: Semiconductor Industry Association (2025). 2025 SIA Factbook. semiconductors.org
limitations: Full databook requires SIA membership; PDF figures not machine-readable; sales data rather than production/capacity data

description: Monthly global semiconductor unit sales and revenues by product category and region. Published monthly with ~45-day lag.
variables: Total semiconductor sales (USD millions), by product category (logic, memory, analog, discrete, sensors), by region
citation: World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (2026). WSTS Market Statistics. wsts.org
limitations: Full historical data requires WSTS membership; free monthly press releases provide only aggregate totals

description: AI-generated product-level indicators at HS6 level including semiconductor/microchip content classification, perishability, hazardous materials flag. Open versioned database.
variables: Rauch classification, UN BEC categories, perishability class, hazardous materials flag, microchip/semiconductor content flag, 3TG conflict-mineral flag
citation: Kiel Institute (2026). PLAID: Product-Level AI-Derived Indicators Database. ifw-kiel.de
limitations: AI-generated — may contain classification errors; beta as of 2026

dataset_name: UN Comtrade HS Chapter 85 (Electrical Machinery / Semiconductors)
description: Bilateral trade in semiconductors, integrated circuits, and electronic components using HS chapter 85 / sub-headings 8541–8542.
variables: HS code 8541 (diodes, transistors), 8542 (ICs), value (USD), quantity, importer, exporter, year
citation: United Nations. UN Comtrade Database (HS 8541–8542). comtradeplus.un.org
limitations: As per UN Comtrade limitations; country self-reporting inconsistencies for high-tech products

description: Comprehensive global energy: oil, gas, coal, electricity, renewables — production, consumption, trade, prices, reserves.
variables: Crude oil production/consumption/stocks/prices, natural gas production/trade/prices, coal statistics, electricity generation by source, petroleum product prices, proved reserves
citation: US Energy Information Administration. International Energy Statistics. eia.gov/international
limitations: US-focused primary data; international data sourced from IEA/IEA for non-US countries with potential lags

description: Tracks national fiscal policy responses to energy price shocks; quantifies government spending on energy subsidies and relief packages.
variables: Government energy support spending (€ billion/% GDP), policy instruments (price caps, subsidies, windfall taxes), country breakdown
citation: Bruegel (2026). National Policies to Shield Consumers from Rising Energy Prices. bruegel.org
limitations: Limited to government policy response data, not energy prices themselves

provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
description: 800,000+ economic and financial time series: interest rates, exchange rates, equity indices, bond yields, monetary aggregates, credit spreads.
variables: S&P 500, VIX, 10yr Treasury yield, federal funds rate, exchange rates, credit spreads, monetary base, bank lending rates, LIBOR/SOFR, CPI, PPI
citation: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. FRED Economic Data. fred.stlouisfed.org
limitations: US-centric primary coverage; international series may be sourced from other providers with different update timing

description: Global banking statistics, debt securities, OTC derivatives, credit-to-GDP, policy rates, effective exchange rates.
variables: Locational banking statistics, consolidated banking statistics, debt securities (domestic/international), OTC derivatives (notional/gross), credit-to-GDP gaps, policy rates (daily/monthly), FX rates
citation: Bank for International Settlements. BIS Statistics. data.bis.org
limitations: Banking statistics based on reporting country data which may not capture offshore centers fully; some data confidential at bilateral level

description: Comprehensive country-level financial statistics: monetary accounts, balance of payments, exchange rates, international reserves, interest rates.
variables: Exchange rates (nominal, real), international reserves, money supply (M1/M2), interest rates, CPI, BoP current account, financial account, capital flows
citation: International Monetary Fund. International Financial Statistics (IFS). data.imf.org
limitations: Monthly data may have 3–6 month lag for some countries; exchange rate data quality varies for countries with dual rates

provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
description: US Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, CPI-W, Core CPI) and Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE). Also hosts OECD CPI series for international data.
geographic_scope: US primary; OECD countries via FRED
variables: CPI-U, Core CPI, PCE, Core PCE, energy CPI, food CPI, shelter CPI, medical care CPI, used cars CPI, OECD CPI all countries
citation: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. FRED Economic Data. fred.stlouisfed.org
limitations: US headline series; international via FRED may have different methodologies than source countries

dataset_name: OECD Consumer and Producer Price Indices
description: Harmonized CPI and PPI for OECD + G20 + OECD accession countries. Monthly headline and core inflation; sectoral breakdowns.
variables: Headline CPI, core CPI (ex-food and energy), energy CPI, food CPI, housing CPI, PPI for manufacturing (total and domestic), PPI by activity
citation: OECD (2026). Consumer and Producer Price Indices. oecd.org/en/data
limitations: Methodology differences across countries despite harmonization efforts; limited sub-annual breakdown for smaller OECD members

dataset_name: IMF World Economic Outlook — Inflation Forecasts
description: CPI inflation forecasts and historical data by country, from WEO database. Both actual and IMF staff projections.
variables: Annual average CPI inflation, end-of-period CPI, GDP deflator, PCE inflation (select countries)
citation: IMF. WEO Database. imf.org
limitations: Annual frequency only in WEO; some high-inflation country data reported as estimates

description: Monthly composite food price index covering cereals, oilseeds, dairy, meat, sugar. Used to monitor global food markets.
variables: FFPI composite, cereals index, oilseeds index, dairy index, meat index, sugar index
citation: FAO. Food Price Index. fao.org/worldfoodsituation/foodpricesindex/en
limitations: Aggregate index only; no bilateral or country-specific breakdowns; commodity basket based on trade weights

description: GDP-weighted average of national EPU indices for 18 countries. Each national index = frequency of newspaper articles with economy + policy + uncertainty keywords.
variables: GEPU composite, country-level EPU (22 countries), newspaper-based frequency counts, standardized score
citation: Baker, S., Bloom, N., & Davis, S. (2016). "Measuring Economic Policy Uncertainty." Quarterly Journal of Economics, 131(4):1593–1636
limitations: Based on English-language or translated media; keyword matching may miss policy uncertainty in non-Western media contexts

dataset_name: ACLED — Armed Conflict Location & Event Data
provider: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project
description: Geo-coded, date-specific, real-time conflict event data: battles, explosions, protests, riots, strategic developments. Widely used in economic conflict studies.
variables: Event type, sub-event type, country, region, administrative division, location (lat/lon), date, actors involved, fatalities, notes
citation: Raleigh, C. et al. (2010). "Introducing ACLED: An Armed Conflict Location and Event Dataset." Journal of Peace Research, 47(5):651–660
limitations: Requires registration; may undercount events in low-media-coverage areas; event taxonomy can be contested

dataset_name: GDELT — Global Database of Events, Language and Tone
description: Real-time global news monitoring: 100+ billion data points from TV, print, and online media in 65+ languages. Events, themes, geographic entities, tone.
variables: Event type (CAMEO codes), actor 1/2, event action, geo-coded location, tone score, goldstein scale, source URL, theme mentions, entity counts
citation: Leetaru, K. & Schrodt, P. (2013). "GDELT: Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone." ISA 2013
limitations: Extremely large volume (terabytes); automated extraction may produce false positives; tone measurement not validated against ground truth

description: Companion to GDELT Events: maps themes, emotions, organizations, people, events mentioned in global news. Structured semantic layer over news corpus.
variables: Theme, person, organization, location, tone, event date, URL, wordcount, V2Counts, V2Themes, V2Tone, GCAM sentiment scores
citation: GDELT Project. GKG v2.0. gdeltproject.org
limitations: Very large data volume; text processing intensive; requires NLP pipeline to extract economic signal

description: Country/region-level instability scores derived from GDELT event data. Accessible via REST API by country code.
variables: Instability score (0–10), conflict events, protest events, violence sub-scores
citation: GDELT Project. GDELT Instability API. gdeltproject.org
limitations: Scores derived from news media density — areas with poor media coverage underrepresented

description: All WEO vintages since 2007 available as downloadable files. Enables comparison of forecasts vs. actuals.
variables: All 45 WEO indicators with vintage history; GDP, inflation, trade, debt, fiscal
citation: IMF. WEO Databases Archive. imf.org
limitations: Download URL changes each release; must be scraped by vintage

description: Full historical WDI download: 1,400+ indicators for 217 countries from 1960. Enables construction of pre-crisis/post-crisis panels.
variables: All WDI indicators — see entry 9
citation: World Bank. WDI. databank.worldbank.org
limitations: See entry 9

provider: World Bank Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
description: Post-disaster needs assessment (PDNA) data, damage and loss estimates for natural disasters. Country-level economic damage as % of GDP.
variables: Damage (physical assets), economic losses, recovery needs, GDP %, sector breakdown (housing, infrastructure, productive, social, cross-cutting)
citation: World Bank GFDRR. Disaster Risk Data. gfdrr.org
limitations: PDNAs conducted only for major disasters in developing countries; no real-time standardized feed

provider: Centre for Research on the Epidemiology of Disasters (CRED), Université Catholique de Louvain
description: Structured database of 22,000+ natural and technological disasters since 1900. Includes economic damage estimates.
variables: Disaster type, country, start/end date, deaths, injured, affected, homeless, total damage (USD), insured losses
citation: Guha-Sapir D. (2026). EM-DAT: The Emergency Events Database. cred.be
limitations: Economic damage estimates incomplete and inconsistent across events; reporting heavily biased toward documented events

description: Extensive historical US macroeconomic data going back to the 1800s. Also hosts NBER recession dates (USREC indicator).
variables: GDP, industrial production, price levels, interest rates, monetary aggregates, recessions dates, unemployment, trade
citation: National Bureau of Economic Research. NBER Data. nber.org
limitations: US-centric; pre-1947 data involves significant estimation uncertainty

description: Annual flagship report on global maritime transport markets: fleet size, port throughput, freight rates, trade volumes. Accompanying datasets released publicly.
variables: World fleet by flag/type, port container throughput (TEU), freight rate indices, liner shipping schedules, trade volumes by sea
citation: UNCTAD (2025). Review of Maritime Transport. unctad.org
limitations: Annual publication only; data lag of ~1 year; freight rate coverage limited to published indices

description: Air passengers carried, air freight (million ton-km), registered carrier departures. Sourced from ICAO via WDI.
variables: Air passengers carried, air freight ton-km, aircraft departures
citation: World Bank / ICAO. Air Transport Statistics. data.worldbank.org
limitations: Annual only; no airline-specific or route-specific breakdown; ICAO data submission lags

description: Annual data on transport infrastructure investment and capital stock: road, rail, inland waterways, maritime.
variables: Road investment (% GDP), rail investment (% GDP), capital stock by transport mode, transport network length
citation: OECD (2026). Infrastructure Investment Statistics. oecd.org/en/data
limitations: OECD countries only; classification differences across countries; some gaps in capital stock data

dataset_name: WITS — UNCTAD TRAINS Tariff & NTM Data
description: Non-tariff measures and preferential tariff rates at HS6 level enabling dependency analysis with trade barriers.
variables: NTM type (A-P UNCTAD classification), HS6 product, reporter, partner, tariff rate (MFN, preferential)
citation: UNCTAD / World Bank. TRAINS Database via WITS. wits.worldbank.org
limitations: NTM data very sparse; self-reported; not all countries submit to TRAINS regularly

dataset_name: Atlas of Economic Complexity — Product Space
description: Network of product relatedness based on revealed comparative advantage co-occurrence. Enables modeling of structural economic dependencies and shock propagation through product space.
variables: RCA (revealed comparative advantage), product space adjacency matrix, economic complexity index (ECI), product complexity index (PCI), opportunity gain, proximity matrix
citation: Hidalgo, C.A. & Hausmann, R. (2009). "The Building Blocks of Economic Complexity." PNAS, 106(26):10570–10575
limitations: Complexity indices based on export diversification; does not capture service trade; structural lags in data
